newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP to bid for Bureau Veritas - paper.
newsitem.headline: CGIP to bid for Bureau Veritas - paper.

text.p: A French weekly financial newspaper said in an article to be published on Saturday that industrial holding group CGIP was preparing to make an offer for unquoted quality control and certification firm Bureau Veritas.

The Journal des Finances, which supplied Reuters with a copy of its article in advance, said it had confirmed the plan with CGIP sources and the offer was likely to be announced by CGIP at an annual shareholders' meeting on June 4.
It said the offer for the unquoted Bureau Veritas could total "not too far off one billion francs".
CGIP has holdings in the packaging industry and is the biggest shareholder in car parts manufacturer Valeo.
